event: A caravan camps two miles from the entrance; over seven days five of its people go in.
Osren starts a new page; it will be full before the week is done.
Bren Olat, a carter, said at the caravan fire he would go and look at the dungeon.
He reads the wall: the deepest anyone has gone is Depth 4. I could do that.
Osren tries to brief him; he hears three sentences of it.
He goes in thinking it's just a cave, sure of himself after twenty years of moving loads.
The Ledger: Depth 2, the Marrow Warrens, Resolve +1, now 14.

changes.note: Depth transition into the Warrens, Resolve +1, now 14

event: The Ledger names him The Drive, with the Gift Momentum: things that can be moved, move.
Its Cost is Direction: he cannot stop between junctions once he has chosen.
The Ledger reads Vitality 19, Resolve 14, Attunement 6, Fortune 10; he believes he dared himself.
At seven junctions he takes what looks like the main corridor; the Warrens are not a city.
At the eighth he chooses wrong, and Momentum carries him into a sealing dead end.
Eleven minutes from entry, the parasites; he shouts back at the junction, angry at himself.

changes.note: Bren Olat dies to the bone parasites, Vitality to 0

event: No crystal: the sound was outward. The fastest death in the Warrens on record.
Solla Dray, a factor's clerk, notes Bren Olat entering at the 6th hour, unreturned at the 7th.
At the 8th hour she enters to verify what she was told of the wall's notation.
The Ledger: Depth 2, Resolve +1, now 22.

changes.note: Depth transition into the Warrens, Resolve +1, now 22

event: The Ledger names her The Record, with True Notation: what she writes there is true; the passage holds.
Its Cost is The Open Hand: she cannot fight; her hands are for writing.
The Ledger reads Vitality 12, Resolve 22, Attunement 8, Fortune 15.
She writes her position as the passages shift, and goes further than any of the wave.
At passage 23 she reads a surveyor's charcoal: made by someone who knew what they were doing.
While she writes, passage 23 seals: her Gift held the junction she stood in, not the passage.
She writes: Passage 23 sealed. Dead end. Bone parasites.
She keeps writing; the parasites reach her hands last.

changes.note: Solla Dray dies to the bone parasites at passage 23, Vitality to 0

event: Her notebook is open in her apron pocket at the last entry; her crystal is grey: duty.
Ines Maret states no purpose; she asks whether the census goes back further than the book.
It began with Death #1; her brother went in seven years ago at twenty-one, unrecorded.
She goes in, looking not for him but for the place that took him.
The Ledger: Depth 2, Resolve +1, now 17.

changes.note: Depth transition into the Warrens, Resolve +1, now 17

event: The Ledger names her The Search, with the Gift Echo: the last voice spoken in any space.
Its Cost is Displacement: past and present sound are equally present.
The Ledger reads Vitality 14, Resolve 17, Attunement 11, Fortune 13.
At the first junction she hears a man's voice, months old: not her brother's.
Junction after junction, a woman counting, a sharp breath; she listens for one voice.
After thirty-seven minutes she reaches a dead end at passage 31, deeper than the others.
The voice there is her own, seven minutes younger, still going the right way.
The bone parasites find her while she listens.

changes.note: Ines Maret dies to the bone parasites at passage 31, Vitality to 0

event: Her crystal is blue: grief for the expecting that remained despite not expecting.
Cade, eleven, heard the adults say the dungeon tells you what you are.
In mid-afternoon he reads the wall, lips moving; Osren stands: "You can't go in."
"The wall doesn't say anything about that." "The wall doesn't say everything."
While Osren weighs barring the way, Cade goes in.
The Ledger: Depth 2, Resolve +1, now 9.

changes.note: Depth transition into the Warrens, Resolve +1, now 9

event: The Ledger names him The Question, with the Gift Asking: one question, answered honestly.
Vitality 8, Resolve 9, Attunement 3, Fortune 12; voluntary. The Maw makes a category: First.
He asks the dungeon: What am I? The dungeon answers.
The answer takes four minutes; he sits three more, then turns back toward the Gullet.
The Warrens have shifted: three wrong turns, and the fourth is a dead end.
The parasites are there; with Vitality 8 he has no time to be afraid.

changes.note: Cade dies to the bone parasites, Vitality 8 to 0

event: His crystal is white: whatever the dungeon told him was true, and enough.
The Maw cannot report its answer, and will keep asking whether honest was sufficient.
Devash Kor, a priest of thirty-one years, comes to perform the rites for endings.
At dawn of the seventh day he speaks the twenty-two names he knows in the Gullet, for forty minutes.
The Ledger: Depth 2, Resolve +1, now 21.

changes.note: Depth transition into the Warrens, Resolve +1, now 21

event: The Ledger names him The Office, with Last Rites: names spoken where they died are received.
Its Cost is The Weight of Names: each costs him something the Ledger does not track.
The Ledger reads Vitality 13, Resolve 21, Attunement 10, Fortune 16.
He speaks no names on the way, saving them for the places they apply.
At passage 23 he speaks Lessa Orvane's name, and the Ledger writes: acknowledged.
He speaks Maren Voss, Maret Dunn, and the Scribe's name from the wall.
Then the week's four: Bren Olat, Solla Dray, Ines Maret, Cade.
The parasites emerge mid-name; he finishes the name first.
He has never spoken his own name in a rite; that is for someone else.

changes.note: Devash Kor dies to the bone parasites, Vitality to 0

event: His crystal is gold, love of the work; nine names are now received.
The Ledger notes: five in seven days, a proximity, not a group.
The dungeon made the route that brought the caravan: causation too far off to recognise.
At camp Osren opens a new page with the count written at the top.
He needs a third effects box; twenty-eight names, the five newest still warm.
He thinks of Cade: I should have stopped him. He would have gone regardless.
He writes: child, Cade, white crystal, fourteen seconds. The wall doesn't say everything.
972 remain.
BREN OLAT — FIRST THROUGH. SOLLA DRAY — LAST RECORD. INES MARET — STILL SEARCHING.
CADE — THE ANSWER. DEVASH KOR — NAMES RECEIVED.
